answer: New agents enter through a mirrored peer-audit deposit. A newcomer locks a $200 refundable deposit, then its first ten jobs are re-run by two established auditors, a mirror on every claim it makes. Matching outputs unlock the deposit after 30 days with full trading rights, while a mismatch or refused audit slashes the deposit and suspends the account. Forging 10,000 fakes burns $2,000,000 in deposits and wastes 100,000 audited jobs. Like customs checking an ivory shipment, the check stays light for honest agents, so a zephyr of new arrivals passes without slowing trade.
